venue.name: Veterans Park
venue.parking: Free main paved lot (Fields 1-4). Overflow grass lot at east end (Fields 5-6). No parking on grass near Fields 1-2. Arrive 30-45 min early.

layoutNotes.1_2: Near main lot, west restrooms, concessions
layoutNotes.3_4: Near central pavilion, bathrooms, AED, team tent area
layoutNotes.5_6: Near east restrooms, overflow parking. Field 6 is turf.
